# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta1

## Opt-in Multi mower site view

- Adds the first **Multi mower** view using the Navimower integration's server-side Site API and precomputed mower-local -> common-site SVG transforms. The browser does not georeference every polygon or trail point itself.
- Multi mower is deliberately **opt-in**. Existing cards remain in the current Single mower view until the user turns Multi on; the choice is remembered per card anchor in that browser and can always be switched back to Single.
- Requires **Navimower 0.4.4-beta4 or newer** for Multi mower mode. The Multi control stays unavailable unless the Site API exposes the beta4 west-to-east member handoff.
- Draws validated nearby mower maps in one common viewport while preserving each member's current-cycle mowing area, zones, Off-limit/VF-off areas, Channels, Gate areas, Custom Areas, dock and dense live mower pose.
- Uses the existing model-aware mower artwork independently for every site member and adds a small mower-name label next to each live mower in Multi mode.
- Places mower control groups in stable **west-to-east** order from the integration's site metadata. Each mower gets its own Mow, conditional Resume, Pause and Home controls.
- Moves Schedule access into each mower's control group as a compact **mower name + calendar icon** button, in the same west-to-east order. Schedule commands and dialogs remain targeted to that mower only.
- Groups session rows by mower with a small mower name heading. Session selection is scoped by `entry_id + session_id`, so histories from different mowers cannot collide.
- Keeps one shared Notifications panel in Multi mode, merges the member notification feeds newest-first and labels every message with the originating mower. Mark read and Mark all as read remain targeted to the correct mower device.
- Keeps the existing 0.3.5 Single mower rendering, controls, Schedule, Notifications, sessions, zoom/pan and editor behavior unchanged when Multi mower is off.

This is the first field-test beta of the combined site renderer. Multi mower intentionally stays user-controlled rather than turning on automatically when a second mower is discovered.
